030package dev.visdb.seesaw.formatting;
031
032import java.text.NumberFormat;
033import java.text.ParseException;
034import java.text.ParsePosition;
035
036import javax.swing.text.NumberFormatter;
037
038import static dev.visdb.seesaw.utils.JStuff.sf;
039
040/**
041 * Number formatter that requires a parse of the complete string to succeed.
042 */
043@SuppressWarnings("serial")
044public class SsNumberFormatter extends NumberFormatter implements FormatterAssist {
045  /**
046   *
047   * @param format
048   */
049  public SsNumberFormatter(NumberFormat format) {
050    super(format);
051    setCommitsOnValidEdit(true);
052  }
053
054  /**
055   * The Format associated with the FormattedTextField.
056   * @return format
057   */
058  @Override
059  public SsFormat getSSFormat() {
060    if (getFormattedTextField() instanceof SsFormattedTextField ftf)
061      return ftf.getSsFormat();
062    return null;
063  }
064
065  /**
066   * If the value is not a String and there is a converter,
067   * then first convert the value before super.valueToString.
068   * @param value
069   * @return String representation of the value
070   * @throws ParseException
071   */
072  @Override
073  public String valueToString(Object value) throws ParseException {
074    String string;
075
076    // TODO: handle a converter, see SSMaskFormatterFactory
077    //s = assistValueToString(value);
078
079    //Object v = value instanceof String s ? stringToValue(s) : value;
080    Object v = value;
081
082    string = super.valueToString(v);
083    return string;
084  }
085
086  /**
087   * First convert the string with super.stringToValue,
088   * then use the converter (if there is one) to create
089   * the value object.
090   * @param s
091   * @return
092   * @throws ParseException
093   */
094  @Override
095  public Object stringToValue(String s) throws ParseException {
096    if (s == null || s.isBlank()) {
097      if (getFormattedTextField() instanceof SsFormattedTextField ftf && !ftf.getAllowNull())
098        throw new ParseException("Null value not allowed", 0);
099      return null;
100    }
101    ParsePosition ppos = new ParsePosition(0);
102    getFormat().parseObject(s, ppos);
103    if (s.length() != ppos.getIndex())
104      throw new ParseException(sf("In '%s' parse finished at %d ", s, ppos.getIndex()),
105                               ppos.getIndex());
106    // Only need to do following so that min/max constraints are checked.
107    return super.stringToValue(s);
108    // TODO: handle a converter, see SSMaskFormatterFactory
109  }
110}
